newsitem.title: UK: BICC warns on H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: BICC warns on H1 profits.

text.p: British cables and cables systems manufacturer BICC Plc said on Wednesday that profits for the first half could be weaker than expected.

"Profits for the first half of this year are likely to be weaker than we had previously expected, nevertheless I see no reason for altering the general comments which we have already made on the outlook for the group," chairman William Weir said in a statement.

The company said BICC Cables continued to face difficult trading conditions in the European power utility market, particularly in Germany and Italy where demand and price levels had deteriorated further.
"This situation is unlikely to change, and largely reflects the tight economic policies continental governments feel obliged to pursue," the company said.
But it said its other worldwide cable activities, excluding Australia, and its Balfour Beatty civil engineering unit were performing in line with expectations.
BICC noted that it had now filled a gap in its extra-high voltage cable business order book.
